Title: [Perf] [AMD] dsv4: Use the aiter MegaMoE small- and large-input paths

Opt-in switches for the two aiter MegaMoEV2 paths (needs ROCm/aiter#6881):

- SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_SMALL_M: steps whose DP-global max token count fits the small-input runtimes (up to 512 tokens per rank) call forward_small_m(), one kernel for quant, dispatch, GEMM1, GEMM2 and combine.
- SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_LARGE_M: extend steps with at least SGLANG_OPT_AITER_MEGA_LARGE_M_MIN_TOKENS (default 1024) tokens on some DP rank run the persistent large-input kernel.

Each MoE layer gets its own protocol slot on the shared operator, and the choice of path depends only on DP-gathered counts, so every EP rank takes the same path.

<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.

Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

DeepSeek-V4-Pro served with `TP8 DP8(attn) EP8` and `--moe-a2a-backend megamoe` on MI355X runs every MoE call through aiter MegaMoEV2. ROCm/aiter#6881 adds two faster MegaMoEV2 paths for this layout; this PR lets SGLang use them. Both are opt-in and the default path does not change.

**Depends on ROCm/aiter#6881; merge that one first.** Without it, the new switches raise an error at startup and nothing else changes.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- New switches in `environ.py`, all off by default: `SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_SMALL_M`, `SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_LARGE_M` and `SGLANG_OPT_AITER_MEGA_LARGE_M_MIN_TOKENS` (default 1024). Smaller extend steps stay on the main path; the large-input path is turned on per step with `set_large_m_enabled()`.
- The path choice uses only DP-gathered counts (`original_global_num_tokens_cpu`, `get_dp_global_num_tokens()`), and `require_mlp_tp_gather` returns true when the small-input switch is on, so captured graphs get DP-synchronized buckets.
- Each MoE layer gets its own protocol slot on the shared operator (`bind_layer`); the draft model's layers get their own slots too.
- Works with `SGLANG_AMD_FLYDSL_MEGA_MOE_DECODE_MTPR`: the large-input path is used only on the full-capacity instance.
- Only `layers/moe/mega_moe_flydsl.py` (the AMD MegaMoE adapter), `environ.py` and one branch in `require_mlp_tp_gather` that runs only with the MegaMoE backend change. CUDA paths cannot reach this code.
- CPU unit test `test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_mega_moe_small_large_m.py`: with the switches off the main path is untouched; with them on, every rank picks the same path from the DP-gathered counts (the small-input and extend thresholds), each MoE layer keeps its own slot, and a switch without the aiter path fails at first use.

Related open PRs: none change the AMD MegaMoE adapter (`mega_moe_flydsl.py`). The open MegaMoE PRs (#46056, #45905, #45613, #44359) are on the NVIDIA / FlashInfer MegaMoE path.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

GSM8K, 1319 questions, 5-shot, real speculative verification (no acceptance simulation), c384 server setup; measured with ROCm/aiter#6881 before its review changes, to be re-measured on the final aiter code:

| | accuracy |
|---|---|
| MegaMoEV2 (both switches off) | 0.932–0.938 |
| this PR (both switches on) | 0.926–0.948 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Setup:

- Workload: InferenceX AgentX (aiperf `--scenario agentx`, dataset `semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126`), 3600 s per run, concurrency 128 / 256 / 384, two runs per arm.
- Model and server: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, `TP8 DP8(attn) EP8`, MegaMoE a8w4 with MTPR 8192, DSPARK speculative decoding with the InferenceX acceptance simulation (`SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.77`, the same accept length on both arms), sglang-router cache_aware + dp-aware. Server, router and client flags are those of InferenceX run [37608671586](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37608671586).
- Hardware and image: one node, 8 × MI355X, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm720-mi35x-20261007`.
- Baseline: the image as is (MegaMoEV2). This PR: the same image and flags with the aiter small- and large-input paths and these switches turned on. Measured before the rebase onto current main and before the review changes in ROCm/aiter#6881 (skewed-routing fixes); the SGLang code path is unchanged by either. To be re-measured on the final aiter code.

Total token throughput = all input tokens (including prefix-cache hits) plus output tokens, per second per GPU (tok/s/GPU); run 1 / run 2, gain of the means:

| conc | baseline | this PR | gain |
|---|---|---|---|
| 128 | 42,810 / 43,060 | 47,137 / 47,425 | +10.1% |
| 256 | 65,795 / 67,857 | 73,217 / 73,796 | +10.0% |
| 384 | 76,192 / 73,603 | 78,880 / 79,776 | +5.9% |

Run-to-run spread: ≤1.1% with this PR, ≤3.4% for the baseline. Below c128 the InferenceX recipe uses TP8 without EP, so this PR does not apply there.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

     return _MEGA_MOE_INSTANCE[(*shape_key, mtpr)]
 
 
+def _large_m_enabled() -> bool:
+    return envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_LARGE_M.get()
+
+
+def _use_large_m(forward_batch: ForwardBatch | None) -> bool:
+    if not (
+        _large_m_enabled()
+        and forward_batch is not None
+        and not get_is_capture_mode()
+        and forward_batch.is_extend_in_batch
+    ):
+        return False
+    # Use the scheduler's raw all-gathered counts, which match on every rank;
+    # global_num_tokens_cpu is rewritten to [1] * dp when an idle rank runs a
+    # one-token extend.
+    gathered = forward_batch.original_global_num_tokens_cpu
+    min_tokens = envs.SGLANG_OPT_AITER_MEGA_LARGE_M_MIN_TOKENS.get()
+    return not (gathered and max(gathered) < min_tokens)
+
+
+def _small_m_tokens(mega, forward_batch) -> int:
+    """DP-global max rows when this call takes the small-input path, else 0."""
+    if not envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_SMALL_M.get() or forward_batch is None:
+        return 0
+    if mega.small_m_mtpr <= 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_SMALL_M is set but the aiter small-input path is "
+            "not available (is AITER_MEGA_SMALL_M=1 set?)"
+        )
+    if forward_batch.is_extend_in_batch:
+        return 0
+    # DP-gathered counts (or, in capture, the DP-synchronized graph bucket) are
+    # the same on every rank, so every EP rank makes the same choice.
+    global_num_tokens = get_dp_global_num_tokens()
+    if not global_num_tokens:
+        return 0
+    max_tokens = max(global_num_tokens)
+    return max_tokens if max_tokens <= mega.small_m_mtpr else 0
+
+
+def _fused_paths_enabled() -> bool:
+    return _large_m_enabled() or envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_SMALL_M.get()
+
+
+def _bind_fused_paths(mega, layer, *, use_large_m: bool) -> None:
+    """Bind this layer's weights and protocol slot; one operator serves every path."""
+    if _large_m_enabled() and mega.large_m_available:
+        mega.set_large_m_enabled(use_large_m)
+    mega.bind_layer(
+        layer_slot=_LAYER_SLOTS.setdefault(id(layer), len(_LAYER_SLOTS)),

+        w1_scale=layer._mega_w1_scale,
+        w2=layer._mega_w2,
+        w2_scale=layer._mega_w2_scale,

+"""MegaMoE small- and large-input switches must pick one path on every EP rank.
+
+Exercises the real host dispatch in ``mega_moe_flydsl`` with CPU tensors and a
+fake AITER operator that records which path each call takes. GPU collectives
+and the kernels themselves are out of scope.
+"""
+
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import sglang.srt.layers.moe.mega_moe_flydsl as mega
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+

+def test_switches_off_keep_the_main_path(runtime):
+    assert runtime.run(7, [7, 300]) == ("main", 7)
+    assert runtime.run(4096, [4096], extend=True) == ("main", 4096)
+    assert "large_m_state_slots" not in runtime.built
+    assert not [call for call in runtime.calls if call[0] == "bind"]
+

+@envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_SMALL_M.override(True)
+def test_small_m_uses_the_dp_global_max_on_every_rank(runtime):
+    # Ranks with different local rows see the same gathered counts, so all of
+    # them call the small-input kernel with the same max_tokens.
+    counts = [7, 300, 0, 64, 1, 512, 2, 9]
+    assert [runtime.run(rows, counts) for rows in counts] == [("small", 512)] * 8
+    # One rank above the small-input capacity moves the whole step to main.
+    # (An idle rank runs one sentinel row.)
+    counts = [7, 513, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
+    assert [runtime.run(rows, counts) for rows in counts] == [
+        ("main", max(r, 1)) for r in counts
+    ]
+    # Extend steps never take the small-input path.
+    assert runtime.run(7, [7], extend=True) == ("main", 7)
+
+
+@envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_LARGE_M.override(True)
+def test_large_m_follows_the_dp_global_max_of_extend_steps(runtime):
+    # The extend threshold (default 1024) is on the DP-global max, not the local rows.
+    assert runtime.run(1, [1, 1024], extend=True) == ("large", 1)
+    assert runtime.run(1023, [1023, 5], extend=True) == ("main", 1023)
+    assert runtime.run(7, [7]) == ("main", 7)
+    assert runtime.built["large_m_state_slots"] == LAYERS + mega._LAYER_SLOT_MARGIN
+

+@envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_MEGA_LARGE_M.override(True)
+def test_each_moe_layer_keeps_its_own_protocol_slot(runtime):
